Notes on the picks:
- **Gymnastics Parent and Tot:** The centre's page says the class involves parent participation and is 30 minutes long. It posts the fall term dates but no price. The page I read shows no day or time for this class. The centre's separate fall schedule PDF has a grid, but I did not tie specific slots to this program. The fall session started September 12 and registration opened July 20, so a family joining now would be joining mid-term.
- **Preschool Drop In:** The drop-in pages disagree on the start date. One says it begins September 15 and another says October 9. Both say it runs through June 26.
- **Acton swim lessons:** The Town's page shows the fall price for Acton. I could not tie a day, time or age band to this class, so I left them out. Gellert has its own fall dates, which I did not mix with the Acton price.
